parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: A small flush button made of durable plastic, located on the top or side of the toilet tank.
parts.Functional_description: It activates the flushing mechanism to release water from the tank into the bowl for cleaning.
parts.Movement_description: It moves slightly inward when pressed and returns to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: A flat, hinged cover made of plastic that sits on top of the toilet tank.
parts.Functional_description: It covers the tank to prevent dust and debris from entering and provides a finished appearance.
parts.Movement_description: It can be lifted or removed for maintenance or cleaning purposes.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The main ceramic structure of the toilet that includes the bowl and pedestal.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the user’s weight, holds water, and channels waste to the plumbing system.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part anchored to the floor and connected to the plumbing system.
